headline: Four cookie consent checks to run before Black Friday
dek: A MeasureU guide (sponsored by Cookiebot) lists the usual holiday breakages: tags that fire after a visitor says no, tags that load before consent, ignored opt-out signals, and new promo pages nobody checked.
why: State privacy enforcement is rising, and new holiday landing pages and ad pixels are where small business sites most often break their own consent setup.
doThis: Open your site in a private window, reject cookies, and see whether your ad pixels still fire in the browser network tab.
